cleanBuildRounds.scope: Ten clean release and debug source rebuilds through the new PowerShell/Java builder, deterministic per-mode JAR hashes, all current Java source bytes unchanged, exact name-normalized ECJ baseline class comparison, and full bytecode linkage. Does not prove all original online gameplay semantics.

release.scope: Exact canonical class bytes after descriptor-aware inverse name remapping on both ECJ builds. Debug attributes/stack-map frames excluded; instructions, branch targets, ordered exception tables, member/access metadata, constants, maxStack/maxLocals included. This validates this name-only refactor against the already-rebuilt baseline, not full equivalence to the original JAR or recovery of pre-obfuscation names.
